title: 7-round AES-192: Basic MITM tradeoff: full-key headline

target.description: Reduced-round AES-192, with initial whitening. Section5's partial-decryption boundary uses the final-round byte positions; Section2 describes omission of final MixColumns. Costs follow that source convention. Author-reported complete key-recovery claim, including Step6's remaining-key search; the paper does not separately price that completion.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key; the source attack derivation treats searched round-key bytes without using schedule relations.
setting.key_population: General fixed key; no weak-key restriction.
setting.plaintext_model: Source 2^32 chosen-plaintext structure; Step2's diagonal coordinates differ from the cost paragraph's first-column description. Repeat with changed plaintext sets according to the tradeoff parameters.
assumptions: Offline table generation and online search have different native work units and are kept separate.
The source p.122 converts 2^88 partial decryptions to 2^80 encryption equivalents using its stated factor of 2^8. This conversion is recorded, not independently calibrated.
Step6's remaining-key enumeration has no separate numerical budget; the online figure describes the matching/search phase.
Section5 uses absolute function-value sequences and guesses a transformed penultimate-round-key byte.
Section5.1 samples a 1/n1 fraction of functions and repeats online search n2 times, with n1,n2>1.

time.note: Symbolic online family; no particular n or n1,n2 value is selected.

data.note: Source repeated-structure budget; distinct-query/reuse constraints require further analysis.

memory.note: Source table-sampling factor applied to baseline storage.

preprocessing.note: Source table-sampling factor applied to reusable setup.

success.description: No numerical joint recovery success is established for this endpoint. Store the source per-sequence table-hit curve with its own sampling assumptions; no product across four outputs or key hypotheses is supplied. The complete-key headline additionally requires the recorded completion step. Retain the existing coordinate/formula conflicts, native units and same-assignment costs.

components.description: Section5.1 Equation7, n1,n2>1: reduce the complete table by n1 and repeat with n2 input sets under the source sampling model. The source rounds its limits to63% at n2=n1 and98% at n2=4n1. The actual finite admissible domain, uniformity and dependence remain unproved; the formula is one table hit, not completed recovery.

review.scope: Exact11-page proceedings edition; endpoint-event review of Propositions4–5, Section5 Steps2–6, Equation7 and Table1. No probability was added: single-target table-hit and wrong-sequence models are not a numerical distinguishing advantage or joint selected-material/master-key identification rate. The98% repetition budget is not borrowed across endpoints. Coordinate, formula and completion-cost conflicts remain; not a new full-paper audit.

evidence.locator: PDF5–6 Section4, Propositions4–5; PDF7–9 Section5, Steps2–6, Equation7, Table1 and Section5.3.
evidence.interpretation: Extraction-review scope only: the checked source does not quantify this exact main output at its recorded budget. Separate proof, coordinate, key-schedule and cost obligations remain recorded. All primary probability values, components and scientific conflicts are unchanged. No probability was added and no scientific conflict was resolved.

Later authors restate the old basic seven-round AES192 tradeoff and call its success98%, with D2^(34+n) but a different native time calibration and printed memory2^(210-4n)bytes. Their restatement provides no new joint four-output identification analysis at the old stored costs. Section4 derives65%/98% for distinct new eight-round attacks and budgets, not this endpoint. This synopsis is not used as the aggregate success model; any separately derived selected-material envelope relies on original-source events. Do not overwrite native costs or resolve old formula/coordinate conflicts.

limitations: Results are transcribed from this source version. Full attack searches, costs and success probabilities have not been reproduced.
The source's online and offline numbers are not directly summable without a work-unit conversion. Full master-key completion and table lookup/sorting overheads are not individually costed.
Section5.1's n>16 feasibility statement addresses the reduced preprocessing exponent. It is not a complete admissible domain including data, memory and online costs.

field_conflicts.label: Chosen-plaintext coordinates
field_conflicts.description: Step2 enumerates diagonal whitening-key bytes to arrange one active byte after round1; the following cost paragraph instead describes a varying first plaintext column.

observations.reported: Kinit=(K0_11,K0_22,K0_33,K0_44); choose a set with only C1_11 active.
The 2^32 plaintext structure varies the first column and fixes the rest.

field_conflicts.label: Printed function expansion
field_conflicts.description: The recurrence preceding Proposition2 omits the third-round S-boxes. Printed Equation(1) also differs from the second-round diagonal expressions immediately above it. A separately derived 25-parameter AES factorization passes local component tests; the printed expressions are preserved as discrepant. DTCB09 explicitly corrects Equation1 and the C3_22/C3_44 expansions in Equations2/4, while stating that these errors do not affect DS08 attack applicability. Separate corrected AES factorization is supported, not the literal print.

observations.locator: Printed p.119 recurrence preceding Proposition2; p.120 Equation(1)
observations.reported: The p.119 recurrence is linear in second-round bytes without S-boxes; Equation(1) uses different coefficients for its c4 and c3 terms.

observations.locator: Printed p.119 second-round diagonal equations; p.117 AES round definition
observations.reported: SubBytes precedes ShiftRows/MixColumns every inner round. C2_22=S(3t11+c4)+c6 and C2_33=2S(t11+c3)+c7 require different nested terms in C3_11.

observations.locator: PDF5/printed148 Section4, Equations3–6; PDF4/printed147 corrected recurrence.
